title: Brokerage Pricing Worksheet: The In-Place Home Resale Lowest Closing Price
content:
**Calculation.** The standard lowest closing price of an In-Place Home Resale listing takes as the closing deductions the fees owed on the file where the package deducts fees from the proceeds, the package's transaction fee where it has one, the package's closing fee, the seller's past-due site-lease balance where the package pays it from the proceeds, and the unpaid principal of a Hearthstone Home Finance loan on the home; it then takes the larger of the closing deductions divided by one less the package's commission rate as a fraction and the closing deductions plus the package's minimum commission, and rounds that figure up to the next whole multiple of 100 dollars.

The fees owed on the file are every charge on it less every payment, credit and proceeds deduction on it, never less than zero, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worksheet lines

| Line | Quantity |
|---|---|
| A | Fees owed on the file — counted only on a package that deducts fees from the proceeds |
| B | The package's transaction fee — only on a package that has one |
| C | The package's closing fee |
| D | The past-due balance on the seller's site lease, never below zero — counted only on a package that pays it from the proceeds |
| E | Unpaid principal of the Home Purchase Financing loan from Hearthstone Home Finance on the home (zero where there is none or it is paid off) |
| F | Closing deductions: A plus B plus C plus D plus E |
| G | F divided by one less the package's commission rate as a fraction (on a package whose commission rate is 0.0, F itself) |
| H | F plus the package's minimum commission (on a package that charges no commission, F itself) |
| I | The larger of G and H, rounded up to the next whole multiple of 100; a figure already a whole multiple of 100 stays as it is |

The package figures named in lines B, C, G and H are the package's own rate-card figures.

## Worked figures (hypothetical files)

**Full-Service Resale Brokerage** (commission rate 6.0, minimum commission 3500.00, transaction fee 295.00, closing fee 195.00): fees owed 420.00, no past-due lease balance, loan principal 60000.00. Closing deductions 60910.00. Divided by 0.94: 64797.87. Plus 3500.00: 64410.00. The larger is 64797.87, rounded up to **64800.00**.

Same file with loan principal 38000.00: closing deductions 38910.00; divided by 0.94, 41393.62; plus 3500.00, 42410.00. The larger is 42410.00, rounded up to **42500.00**.

**Owner-Marketed Listing Package** (no commission, no transaction fee, closing fee 150.00, fees and lease arrears not paid from the proceeds), no loan: closing deductions 150.00; both lines give 150.00, rounded up to **200.00**.
